name: Red carpet runner
description: A long deep red wool runner about 1.2 × 4 m lying flat on the floor: a woven border of a gold band between dark indigo lines with a chain of small lozenges along it, a sparse lattice of dark diamonds in the field, a gold lozenge near either end and a short knotted fringe on both short ends.

provenance.prompt: A long red runner with a woven border, about 1.2 × 4 m, a centimetre or two high.
